ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 18 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 35% off to sign up, yet 0 of 29 ads mention percent off. A new buyer has no reason to act today. Put the 35% signup offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

16 of 29 copy ads open on the same line, new season, new signature look. Most of the account repeats one story. Name two or three new angles from your own products, like bead ropes, and run each against it.

Your site answers shipping questions in its FAQ, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. A buyer unsure how the order arrives has a reason to wait. Answer that in line one of ads aimed at new buyers.
One exact copy runs in 16 of 29 ads, so every ad feels like a repeat. Keep the body copy but change the opening line and creative in each ad, so every version reads as fresh.
